_documentation: Magma Maw boss definition. Volcanic mining machine with 7 destructible sections (1 core, 2 drills, 4 turrets) and 3 difficulty phases. Loaded by AssetLoader via libGDX JsonReader into BossData. Sections are independently targetable; destroying them reduces boss capabilities.

_fields.id: Boss identifier string. Must be unique across all boss JSON files. Value: 'magma_maw'.
_fields.name: Display name shown to the player when the boss enters. Value: 'Magma Maw'.
_fields.scoreValue: Points awarded for defeating this boss (integer). Value: 5000.
_fields.sections: Array of boss section objects. Each section has independent HP, position offset, and attack pattern. Total boss HP = sum of all section HP (80+20+20+10+10+10+10 = 160).
_fields.sections[].type: Section type enum. Valid values: CORE, ARM, TURRET, WING, ENGINE, TENTACLE, DRILL, BEAM_EYE, ROTATING_WEAPONS. Maps to BossSection.SectionType. CORE is the main body; DRILL are forward appendages; TURRET are side-mounted guns.
_fields.sections[].hp: Hit points for this individual section (integer, 1-120). When HP reaches 0, the section is destroyed and can no longer attack. CORE typically has the most HP.
_fields.sections[].offsetX: X offset from boss center in pixels (float). Negative = left of center, positive = right. Used to position the section relative to the boss body.
_fields.sections[].offsetY: Y offset from boss center in pixels (float). Negative = above center, positive = below. Used to position the section relative to the boss body.
_fields.sections[].attackPattern: Bullet pattern for this section. Valid values: aimed, aimed_spread, spiral, drill_advance, sweep, beam, area_denial, rotating. Each section fires its own pattern independently.
_fields.phases: Array of phase definitions. Phases are ordered by hpThreshold descending (1.0 -> 0.75 -> 0.25). Boss transitions to the next phase when its total HP drops below the threshold.
_fields.phases[].phase: Phase index (integer, 0-based). Phase 0 = initial, Phase 1 = mid, Phase 2 = enrage/final.
_fields.phases[].hpThreshold: Fraction of total boss HP at which this phase begins (float, 0.0-1.0). Phase 0 starts at 1.0 (full HP). Lower thresholds = later phases.
_fields.phases[].attacks: Array of attack pattern names active in this phase (strings). Each string maps to a named attack routine in the boss Java class. Later phases add more attacks.
_fields.phases[].attackInterval: Seconds between attack triggers in this phase (float, 0.5-3.0). Lower = more aggressive. Decreases in later phases to ramp difficulty.

name: Magma Maw
